connector.name: MinerU Open MCP
connector.registryDescription: Parse PDFs, images, doc, docx, ppt, pptx, xls, xlsx, html into Markdown using MinerU API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mineru-open-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the opendatalab account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MINERU_API_TOKEN
env.description: MinerU API token for full capability (higher limits, extra output formats). Omit to use free Flash mode (Markdown only, 20 pages / 10 MB per file).

env.name: OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Directory for saved parse results when content is written to disk.
